keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Navalcarnero 0, Real Betis 1. Rodrigo Riquelme (Real Betis) right footed shot from a difficult angle and long range on the left to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Aitor Ruibal.
Delay in match (Real Betis).
Delay in match (Navalcarnero).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Varo López (Navalcarnero).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Giovani Lo Celso (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Navalcarnero 0, Real Betis 1.
Second Half begins Navalcarnero 0, Real Betis 1.
Goal! Navalcarnero 1, Real Betis 1. Varo López (Navalcarnero) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Varo López (Navalcarnero) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Betis. Isco replaces Antony.
Substitution, Navalcarnero. Kensly Vázquez Cervera replaces Álvaro Marcos Rivero.
Substitution, Navalcarnero. Javier Álvarez replaces Aarón Fernández.
Substitution, Navalcarnero. Asier replaces Peque.
Substitution, Real Betis. Rodrigo Marina replaces Giovani Lo Celso.
Substitution, Real Betis. Fran García replaces Junior Firpo.
Substitution, Navalcarnero. Mario Jiménez replaces Rober.
Goal! Navalcarnero 2, Real Betis 1. Kensly Vázquez Cervera (Navalcarnero) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Varo López following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Álvaro Calado Tena (Navalcarnero).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Navalcarnero. Luis Jimeno Pérez replaces Jesús Muñoz.
Goal! Navalcarnero 2, Real Betis 2. Rodrigo Marina (Real Betis) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Aitor Ruibal.
Aitor Ruibal (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Mario Jiménez (Navalcarnero) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half Extra Time begins Navalcarnero 2, Real Betis 2.
Goal! Navalcarnero 2, Real Betis 3. Rodrigo Riquelme (Real Betis) with an attempt from very close range to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Substitution, Navalcarnero. Mario Sánchez replaces Roberto Esteban.
Substitution, Real Betis. Marc Bartra replaces Héctor Bellerín.
Delay in match because of an injury Diego Llorente (Real Betis).
Marc Bartra (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Real Betis. Natan replaces Diego Llorente because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half Extra Time begins Navalcarnero 2, Real Betis 3.
Víctor Rodríguez (Navalcarnero) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Isco (Real Betis) right footed shot saved in the top left corner by Álvaro Calado Tena (Navalcarnero).
Second yellow card to Aitor Ruibal (Real Betis) for a bad foul.
Kensly Vázquez Cervera (Navalcarnero) is shown the yellow card.
